# 1 Enoch Chapter 61 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Ge'ez MS | **Section:** Book of Parables

---

**1** And I saw in those days how long cords were given to those angels, and they took to themselves wings and flew, and they went toward the north.

**2** And I asked the angel, saying to him: Why have these taken cords and gone off? And he said to me: They have gone to measure.

**3** And the angel who went with me said: These shall bring the measures of the righteous, and the ropes of the righteous to the righteous, that they may lean upon the name of the Lord of Spirits for ever and ever.

**4** The elect shall begin to dwell with the elect; and these are the measures which shall be given to faith and which shall strengthen righteousness.

**5** And these measures shall reveal all the secrets of the depths of the earth — those who have been destroyed in the desert, and those who have been devoured by the fish of the sea and by wild beasts — that they may return and lean upon the day of the Elect One; for none shall be destroyed before the Lord of Spirits, and none can be destroyed.

**6** And all who dwell above in the heaven received a command and power and one voice and one light like fire.

**7** And that One they blessed in their first words and extolled and lauded with wisdom, and they were wise in utterance and in the spirit of life.

**8** And the Lord of Spirits placed the Elect One on the throne of glory. And he shall judge all the works of the holy ones above in heaven, and in the balance their deeds shall be weighed.

**9** And when he shall lift up his countenance to judge their secret ways according to the word of the name of the Lord of Spirits, and their path according to the way of the righteous judgment of the Lord Most High — they shall all speak with one voice and bless and glorify and extol and sanctify the name of the Lord of Spirits.

**10** And he will summon all the host of the heavens, and all the holy ones above, and the host of God — the Cherubim, the Seraphim, and the Ophanim, and all the angels of power, and all the angels of the principalities — and the Elect One, and the other powers on the earth and over the water.

**11** On that day they shall raise their voice and say: Holy, holy, holy, is the Lord of Spirits — he who fills the earth with spirits.

**12** And in consequence of this there shall be great trembling and great fear on that day; and the Watchers shall quake, and great fear and trembling shall seize them to the ends of the earth.

**13** And the high mountains shall be shaken, and the high hills shall be brought low, and shall melt like wax before the flame. And the earth shall be wholly split apart, and everything on the earth shall perish, and there shall be judgment upon all.

---

*LOGOS notes: Formal equivalence rendering from the Ge'ez text. Ch. 61 builds toward the great judgment scene of ch. 62. The measuring angels (v. 1–5) recall Zech 2 and Ezek 40. The Trisagion (v. 11) adapts Isa 6:3 with 'Lord of Spirits' for 'LORD of hosts.' The threefold angelic hierarchy (Cherubim, Seraphim, Ophanim) is distinctive to the Enochic tradition.*
